description: This file defines a Flutter login page widget (AdminLoginPage) with form validation, API login call, and UI rendering for email/password login. It is part of an admin panel web application.

classes.name: AdminLoginPage
classes.description: A stateful widget representing the admin login screen, accepting an ApiClient instance for login operations.

classes.name: _AdminLoginPageState
classes.description: State class managing the login form, validation, UI state, and login logic.

methods.name: _doLogin
methods.description: Handles the login process: validates form, calls API login, updates UI, and navigates on success.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the login screen, including form fields, error messages, and login button.
